rows.title: Country of origin: no hint and a 'Search for a country' placeholder, in animals and plants
rows.detail: The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the built-now half of the country of origin control. The hint 'Start typing to search for a country.' goes (it also misleads users without JavaScript, who get a plain select), and the type-ahead box shows the placeholder 'Search for a country' while empty. It changes the live-animals origin page and, in the same increment, the high-risk plants frontend's origin page. The control stays the real frontend's accessible autocomplete over a native select: opening on focus, matching, the arrow and its own announcements stay as the component is configured. Plants keeps its own country list, guidance and errors. The germinal products set copies the live-animals origin page and so takes this when it is built.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live-animals origin page, the 'Country of origin' question shows no hint text, with or without JavaScript (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010, p1-013; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-075; conflicts:c-009)

On the live-animals origin page, with JavaScript, the empty country box shows the placeholder 'Search for a country'; without JavaScript the native select still begins with its blank 'Select a country' option (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-032; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-013; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-076; conflicts:c-006, c-009)

On the high-risk plants origin page, the 'Country of origin' question shows no hint text, with or without JavaScript, and keeps its own list, guidance and errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-031, p3-033; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-005, p5-006; conflicts:c-009)

On the high-risk plants origin page, with JavaScript, the empty country box shows the placeholder 'Search for a country'; without JavaScript the native select still begins with its blank 'Select a country' option (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-031; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-007, p5-008; conflicts:c-009)

On both pages the control is still labelled 'Country of origin', choosing a country still saves it and shows it again when the page is reopened, and without JavaScript the native select still saves the chosen country (conflicts:c-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-082; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-010)

With Welsh chosen, the placeholder shows its Welsh counterpart on both pages, and the removed country hint is no longer shown in Welsh either (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-117; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-028, p5-029, p5-030)

sources.ref: repo-plantsfrontend-p5-005 to p5-010, p5-028 to p5-030

notes: Keeps inc-009. Requirements unchanged; provenance re-cited to the afternoon ruling's current claim ids (p1-010, p1-013, p3-031, p3-033) and plants' Welsh claims (p5-028 to p5-030).

Combines the hint and the placeholder, in animals and plants: one control, one review, and the ruling says plants changes in the same increment. The germinal set's origin page is a copy of the live-animals page built in the germinal theme, so the germinal half of 'both animals sets' is observed there: this row's criteria hold before the germinal set exists.

The placeholder may need a new option on the shared accessible-autocomplete component in each frontend (today it reads its config from the select's data attributes), so the component is listed as shared.
The page changes visually; the origin page's full-page baseline (req-058) is refreshed in the region code row that finishes the page.

rows.title: Region of origin code, internal reference hint and the finished origin page
rows.detail: The region of origin code question takes Design Release 2.1's hint and caps the box at 5 characters in the browser, with autocomplete and spellcheck off. Answering No clears a saved code. A code typed under Yes with no country chosen is kept on the page but not saved until a country gives it its prefix. The origin task is complete only when the country and the region question are answered and, under Yes, a code is held. The internal reference hint drops its 58-character sentence (the server still enforces the limit). Every new or changed string on the origin page has Welsh, and the origin page's stored visual baseline is updated to the finished page. The prefix stays server-side as DR1 shipped it; the live prefix waits on design.
acceptanceCriteria: The region of origin code question's hint reads 'Check the health certificate for a region of origin code. You can add the code later if you do not have the certificate now.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-021; conflicts:c-010)

The region code box stops typing at 5 characters and has autocomplete and spellcheck turned off; a longer code submitted without the browser's cap still gets the server's existing error (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-046; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-047; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-023; conflicts:c-010)

Changing a saved Yes answer with code FR-75 to No and saving clears the code: the review page shows 'Not applicable' for the region of origin code, and choosing Yes again shows an empty code box (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-014, p13-017; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-047, p5-048, p5-049; conflicts:c-010)

Answering Yes and typing a region code with no country chosen keeps the typed code on the page, but saves no region of origin code until a country is chosen to give it its prefix (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-056; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-056)

The overview's origin task reads 'Complete' only when a country is chosen and the region of origin code question is answered: a country saved with the region question unanswered does not read 'Complete', a country with No reads 'Complete', and a country with Yes and a code reads 'Complete' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-069; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-053, p5-054, p5-055; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-114)

The internal reference hint reads 'Enter any internal reference you want to use to identify this consignment, or leave blank.', with no 'It can be up to 58 characters.' sentence; a reference over 58 characters still gets the server's error naming the limit (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-063; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-023; conflicts:c-011)

With Welsh chosen, the region hint and the internal reference hint show their Welsh counterparts, and no removed text (the country hint, the 58-character sentence) is left in the origin page's Welsh copy (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-117)

The end-to-end suite's full-page visual baseline of the origin page shows the changed page (no country hint, the country box with its placeholder, the new region hint and the shorter internal reference hint), and the visual check passes against it (trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-060, p4-061, p4-133)
notes: Keeps inc-010. Requirements unchanged; provenance re-cited to the afternoon ruling's current claim id for req-1743 (p1-056). The live prefix (req-040) and the empty prefix slot (req-041) stay in their own waiting-on-design row (design question 2).

Combines the region code slices (hint, maxlength, No clears the code, a code with no country), the origin task's completeness rule, the internal reference hint, the Welsh sweep and the visual baseline: all change the same origin page and its one baseline. Depends on the hint-and-placeholder row (inc-009) so the baseline shows the finished page. If the combiner orders the subdivision label row (req-030) before this one, the baseline also shows it; otherwise that row refreshes the baseline itself.

Completeness: Yes without a code cannot be saved through the page (the page holds the trader with 'Enter the region of origin code'), so the criterion observes the reachable cases; the builder still adds the rule to the origin obligation so a stored Yes with no code is never Complete.

req-057 covers the type and origin pages in animals and the country hint and placeholder in plants. The type page lives in the INS frontend's notification-type folder, which the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns, so the type page's Welsh is built there with req-001 to req-007; the placeholder's and removed hint's Welsh in both frontends is a criterion of inc-009. req-057 sits here, where the last origin strings land, rather than in splitOff, because its remaining work is all on the origin page.

rows.title: The stub's countries match real MDM, and every captured country fixture is recaptured from it
rows.detail: The 9 October ruling's stub tidy-up, countries half. trade-imports-stub's MDM countries fixture is regenerated from MDM's raw responses: all 250 countries in MDM's order with their full real records, served whole, and filtered by the blocks parameter as MDM does. The animals frontend, the high-risk plants frontend, the INS frontend and the tests repo then recapture or derive their country data from what reference data now serves, so every later list row is built and tested against what MDM really serves. The afternoon ruling makes the tidy-up change plants in the same increment.
acceptanceCriteria: Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's MDM countries call without a blocks filter answers all 250 countries in MDM's order with their full real records, in place of today's 31 hand-kept records, and no value MDM masks is filled in (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-147, p1-150, p1-152, p1-153; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-011, p2-047)

Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's countries call for the GBNAG_SPS_EX block answers the 32 countries in that block, as MDM does (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-155; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-005, p2-043, p2-079)
Locally and in CDP dev, the stub serves each country record whole, including fields its own models do not name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-154; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-008, p2-046)

The stub's own tests check the regenerated countries fixture, and check that the blocks filter answers 32 countries for GBNAG_SPS_EX and 250 without it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-156; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-069, p2-070, p2-074)

In the animals frontend's stub mode, the country of origin list offers the same countries, names and order as reference data serves from the tidied stub, and no country check is marked as waiting on an endpoint that is not built (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-157, p1-158; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-077; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-016)

In the high-risk plants frontend's stub mode, the origin page's country list offers the same countries, names and order as reference data serves from the tidied stub for the GBNAG_SPS_EX block, and every plants check that pinned an old country name or count passes against the recaptured list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-030; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p9-102, p5-033)

In the INS frontend's stub mode, the address book's Country select offers the countries captured from the reference data service's unfiltered list, not the four hand-typed ones (United Kingdom, France, Germany, Ireland) (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-143, p1-144, p1-159; conflicts:c-177)

The end-to-end specs take their country names from the recaptured countries fixture, the tests repo keeps no unused hand-kept list of country rows, and every spec that counts the unfiltered country list expects the count served, 249 places on the local stack rather than 31 (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-160, p1-161, p1-162)
notes: Keeps inc-173: this is its countries half. The arrival-and-transit area drafts the ports half (req-1811, req-1812, req-1814, req-1933); the combiner merges the two back into inc-173 and keeps its id, theme (reference-lists) and criteria. mdm/stub-tidy-up-spec.md is the accepted spec (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-164).

Combines the regenerated fixture, the blocks filter, serving records whole, the stub's own tests and every recapture: the recaptures can only be observed once the stub serves the new fixture, and building them apart would repeat the same stub-and-capture set-up.

Merge order: the stub first, then each frontend that recaptures from it, then the tests repo. The subdivision label row (inc-175) and the other country list rows depend on this row, because it changes the names and counts their checks assert.

The INS frontend's Country select is the address book's (insfrontend:src/server/app/services/countries/stub.js holds the four hand-typed countries); that folder is in reference-lists' touches, not the split-off type-question theme's.

rows.title: Country of origin list labels subdivisions with their parent country
rows.detail: Places in the country of origin list that are subdivisions of a country show as '<territory> (<parent>)', for example 'Canary Islands (Spain)', and the list is sorted by the label shown. Which places appear, their names and the stored code stay what MDM serves through the reference data service. c-221 settles it: the label is look and feel, where the prototype wins, and it matches what the 9 October ruling does for the destination select and transit country search.
acceptanceCriteria: In the live-animals country of origin list, every place the reference data service serves as a subdivision of a country shows as '<subdivision name> (<parent country name>)', for example 'Canary Islands (Spain)', with or without JavaScript (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-040-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-136, p1-139; conflicts:c-221)
The country of origin list is sorted alphabetically by the label shown, so 'Canary Islands (Spain)' sits among the C entries (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-040-m1; conflicts:c-221)

Choosing a subdivision still saves its code (ES-CN for the Canary Islands), and reopening the origin page shows 'Canary Islands (Spain)' in the box with the region code prefix ES (trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-021; conflicts:c-221)

The list holds the same places as the reference data service serves for the GBNAG_SPS_EX block, no more and no fewer (repo:referencedata GET /countries; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p6-004; conflicts:c-001)
notes: Keeps inc-175; requirement unchanged. c-221 is settled by precedence, so the row builds the settled outcome. The old criterion's 'typing spain lists Canary Islands (Spain)' clause is dropped: how typed text matches follows the component as configured (c-009), and req-019's mid-name matching is out of scope.

Depends on the stub countries tidy-up (inc-173), which changes the places the list holds and so the names and counts its checks assert. Labels are presentation built in the frontend from the parent and subdivision names reference data already serves; the list's content stays MDM's (c-001), so no reference-data or stub change. Observable on every stack: the tidied stub serves MDM's subdivisions locally and in CDP dev, and real MDM serves its own in CDP test.

The germinal set's origin page copies this behaviour when it copies the page. The destination select and transit country search labels are other areas' rows; if the combiner finds they share one label builder, that builder belongs in the reference-lists theme.

rows.title: The germinal origin page's Back link follows where the notification started
rows.detail: In the germinal products set, the origin page's Back link goes to the notification type question when the notification was started from it, to the germinal products set's own notifications list when started from that list, to the notification overview when opened from the overview, and to the template review when a germinal products template is being edited. This is the germinal half of the origin Back link: the 9 October ruling splits req-013 by set, and the live-animals half went with the split-off type-question-and-templates theme.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification started from the type question, the germinal origin page's Back link goes to the 'What are you importing?' question, which shows Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos) already selected (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; conflicts:c-007)

On a germinal products notification started from the germinal products notifications list's own 'Create new', the origin page's Back link goes to that list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)
Opened from the germinal notification's overview, the origin page's Back link goes to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028-m1; conflicts:c-011)

Opened from the template review while a saved germinal products template is being edited, the origin page's Back link goes to that template's review (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-049)
notes: req-1740 already sits in inc-186 (germinal-products theme), with the templates area's req-1875 and req-1876; its template-review clause needs germinal template mode. Drafted here as this area's part only: the combiner merges it back into inc-186 and keeps that id, its repos (backend joins from req-1875/1876), its dependsOn (inc-182) and its externalDependsOn on the split-off type-question-and-templates workarea (inc-150, inc-151, inc-154 to inc-161, inc-164, inc-165).

Not split off: its code is the germinal set's own origin page (frontend:src/server/app/sets/germinal-products), which the germinal-products theme owns; the split-off theme touches only the live-animals templates and check-answers folders and the INS type page. The Back link to the type question needs the INS type question (split-off), reached through externalDependsOn, never dependsOn.

rows.title: Waiting on design: a Search button beside the country of origin search
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 presents the country of origin control as a search box with its own button. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this a JavaScript-era mechanic beyond the component's own options, so it waits on design question 1, as one waiting-on-design increment shared with the port of entry and transit country boxes. If design asks for it, the box gains a separate 'Search' button on the origin page of both animals sets and of plants; if design drops it, this row is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, the live-animals and plants origin pages' country boxes each have a separate button at their right, showing a search icon with the visually hidden text 'Search' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-032; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-014, p1-055, p3-032; conflicts:c-009)

Without JavaScript, both pages still show the plain labelled 'Country of origin' select and save the chosen country, with no Search button (conflicts:c-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-011)
With Welsh chosen, the button's hidden text shows its Welsh counterpart on both pages (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-117; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-028)
openQuestions: Design question 1 (search buttons): design must say whether the separate 'Search' button beside the country of origin, port of entry and transit country boxes is needed. Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it. No safe default: the ruling puts it to design.
notes: Keeps inc-188: this is its country of origin half. The arrival-and-transit area drafts the port of entry, transit country and place of landing half (req-296); the combiner merges the two back into inc-188, one increment for design question 1 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-055), and keeps its id, theme (waiting-on-design) and dependsOn (inc-009, inc-027).
Depends on inc-009 (the hint and placeholder on the same control). The button is a change to the shared accessible-autocomplete component in each frontend.

rows.title: Country of origin results take the prototype's screen-reader wording, if design says the component's own cannot stand
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 labels the country results 'Country search results' and announces 'Selected <country>' on a choice. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the accessible autocomplete's own announcements now (req-1909) and puts this custom wording to design as question 13. If design says the component's own announcements cannot stand, the origin page of both animals sets and of plants takes the custom wording; otherwise this row is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, on the live-animals and plants origin pages, the country results are labelled 'Country search results' for screen readers, and choosing one announces 'Selected <country>', for example 'Selected France' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-036, p2-037; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-015, p1-058, p3-032; conflicts:c-009)
With Welsh chosen, the results label and the selection announcement show their Welsh counterparts on both pages (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-117; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-028)
openQuestions: Design question 13: design must say whether the accessible autocomplete's own result and selection announcements can stand. The custom wording is built only if design says they cannot; otherwise this row is dropped. No safe default: the ruling puts it to design.
notes: Keeps inc-189. Kept apart from the Search button row because it waits on a different design question. If the arrival-and-transit area drafts the same question for the port and transit boxes, the combiner may merge them into one waiting-on-design row.
Depends on inc-009. The wording is a change to the shared accessible-autocomplete component's messages in each frontend.

rows.title: Region code prefix follows the picked country in the browser, if design asks for it
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 writes the region code prefix the moment the user picks a country, and shows an empty prefix slot before any country is chosen. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the origin page now with the server-side prefix DR1 shipped and puts the live prefix and the empty slot to design as question 2. If design asks for them, with JavaScript the prefix follows the picked country with no submission; if design drops them, this row is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, picking France in the country box makes the region code prefix 'FR', and then picking Netherlands makes it 'NL', with no form submission (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-047, p2-048; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-049, p2-050; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-057; conflicts:c-008)

With JavaScript, before any country is chosen, the revealed region code box shows an empty prefix in front of it, which fills in once a country is picked (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-048; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-034; conflicts:c-008)

Without JavaScript, the prefix still shows the saved or submitted country's code once the page is re-shown, as DR1 shipped it (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p4-002; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-056; conflicts:c-008)

sources.ref: document-dr1-parity-backlog-p4-002, p4-005 to p4-007, p4-009, p4-010

openQuestions: Design question 2 (region code): design must say whether the region code prefix should follow the picked country live in the browser, with an empty prefix slot before a country is chosen. Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it. No safe default: the ruling puts it to design.
notes: Keeps inc-190. Combined because req-040 and req-041 answer the same design question on the same box. Depends on inc-010 (the finished origin page and its baseline, which this row refreshes if built). Live animals only among this programme's built pages; the germinal set's copy of the origin page takes it when built. Plants has no region code question.
The old no-JavaScript criterion cited document-dr1-parity-backlog-p4-008, which is outside this area's slices; it is re-cited to p4-002 and the ruling's p1-056.
